tools.name: tiendanube_start_here
tools.title: Start Here: How To Use This Store MCP
tools.description: CALL THIS FIRST in any conversation about the user's Tiendanube store. Returns the map 'if the user asks X, call tool Y', the golden rules and the list of step-by-step recipes. Use these tools instead of a browser or the admin panel.

tools.name: tiendanube_find_tool
tools.title: Find The Right Tool
tools.description: Use when you do not know which tool does what you need. Describe the job in plain Spanish or English and get the matching tools and recipes. Example arguments: {"query":"subir precios de una categoría"}

query.description: What you want to do, in plain language

tools.name: tiendanube_get_recipe
tools.title: Get A Step-By-Step Recipe
tools.description: Use for multi-step jobs. Returns the exact tools and arguments to use, in order. Pass "id" (see tiendanube_start_here) or a plain-language "query". Without arguments it lists all recipes. Example arguments: {"id":"combo"}

id.description: Recipe id: combo | bulk-price | stock | create-product | images | catalog-audit | seo | orders-to-ship | ship-order | sales-report | coupon | abandoned-carts | fix-access

query.description: Or describe the job in plain language

tools.name: tiendanube_doctor
tools.title: Diagnose Connection And Permissions
tools.description: Check the store connection and scopes. Returns precise next steps and keeps the store's secrets private.

probe_scopes.description: Also test one read endpoint per permission (about 15 quick requests)

tools.name: tiendanube_api_request
tools.title: Generic Tiendanube API Request
tools.description: LAST RESORT before asking the user: call any Tiendanube API route that has no dedicated tool (use tiendanube_find_tool first). The path is relative to the user's own store: do NOT include the version or store id. Only the user's store can be reached. Example arguments: {"method":"GET","path":"/products","query":{"per_page":5}}

path.description: Route relative to the store, e.g. "/products", "/orders/123", "/products/9/variants"

tools.name: tiendanube_product_image_add_from_file
tools.title: Upload A Local Image File To A Product
tools.description: Use this tool, not the browser or the admin panel, to upload an image file from this computer (for example one you just generated with your own image tool) to a product. Accepts JPG, PNG, GIF or WEBP under 10 MB; the file is verified to be a real image. Pass an ABSOLUTE path. Never paste base64 into the chat. For a public URL use tiendanube_product_images_create. Required scope: write_products. Example arguments: {"product_id":123456,"file_path":"/home/user/combo.png","position":1,"alt":{"es":"Combo verano"}}

file_path.description: Absolute path of the image file on this computer

position.description: Position in the gallery (1 = main image)

alt.description: Alt text — i18n object keyed by language code, e.g. {"es": "...", "pt": "...", "en": "..."}

tools.name: tiendanube_create_combo
tools.title: Create A Combo / Pack From Existing Products
tools.description: Use this tool, not the browser or the admin panel, to create a combo / pack / bundle product from products ALREADY in the store, in ONE call: it reads the components, computes the price (sum of component prices minus discount_percent, or your explicit price) and the stock (the scarcest component), builds the description, creates the product and uploads your images. It is created UNPUBLISHED (draft); tell the user and publish with tiendanube_products_update {"id":<id>,"published":true} once they agree. NOTE: the API cannot create native Kits, and a regular combo product does not deduct component stock when sold (warnings are returned). Components with several variants need variant_id. Required scope: read_products + write_products. Example arguments: {"name":"Combo Verano","components":[{"product_id":111,"quantity":1},{"product_id":222,"quantity":2}],"discount_percent":10,"image_files":["/home/user/combo.png"]}

anyOf.description: Combo name — i18n object keyed by language code, e.g. {"es": "...", "pt": "...", "en": "..."}

name.description: Combo name (plain text, or a language object)

variant_id.description: Needed only when the product has more than one variant

quantity.description: Units of this product inside the combo

components.description: Products that make up the combo

discount_percent.description: Discount over the sum of component prices (0-95)

price.description: Explicit combo price; overrides the computed one

anyOf.description: Description (HTML allowed) — i18n object keyed by language code, e.g. {"es": "...", "pt": "...", "en": "..."}

stock.description: Combo stock; default = scarcest component; null = unlimited

image_files.description: Absolute paths of image files to upload (first = main image)

use_component_images.description: If no image_files are given, reuse the components' main photos

dry_run.description: Only compute and return the plan; create nothing
